hooks.prompt: Analyze this session for the skill '{{SKILL_NAME}}'. Evaluate: 1) Did it complete the requested task? 2) Were there errors, retries, or timeouts? 3) Was token usage reasonable? 4) Any unexpected patterns? Respond ONLY with JSON: {"healthy": bool, "completion_score": 1-5, "efficiency_score": 1-5, "reliability_score": 1-5, "issues": [...], "suggested_fixes": [...], "severity": "none|low|medium|high"}
